text_block_list.text:
Asked to help with pool cleaning, I headed 
over to the pool—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm on the poolside duty team. 
Let's get started right away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, before we begin, I have one proposal. 
Could you leave the water channel cleaning 
entirely to me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All of it...? It's pretty huge, so that 
sounds really tough, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing to worry about. Just 
leave it to me for now.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Is Tachyon-san really that confident at 
cleaning too?)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Excelling at studying, running, and even 
cleaning...? That makes her seem way more 
of an honor student than me...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll handle the entire poolside 
myself! Everyone else, please take care of 
the diving boards and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(I'm definitely finishing before 
Tachyon-san does...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Now that it's settled, no wasting time! 
I'll clean thoroughly and with maximum 
efficiency!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that should be all the kickboards. 
Might as well clean the lane ropes while 
I'm at it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oops, I left my essential chemicals 
behind. I must go retrieve them first. 
Heheheh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san isn't done at all! If 
anything, didn't she just make a bigger 
mess...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Don't know what she's plotting, but 
while she's slacking, I'm finishing this!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Alright, done! Fufu, complete victory for 
me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Shortest, fastest, most efficient route 
pays off! Tachyon-san isn't done yet, so 
now—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san! Finished mine, let me help!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, done already? Then we finished at 
same time, fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh, same...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Kuku, just watch.

Saying so, Agnes Tachyon produced test 
tube from pocket and spilled contents. 
Then—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...!? All grime in ditch... 
floated up...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Byproduct of recent experiment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Showed promising cleaning and sterilizing 
effects, so tested it under pretext of 
pool duty.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now drain water and all dirt washes away. 
Sterilized kickboards too while at it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well then. Obtained desired experimental 
results. I shall take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
S-Something's off... Doesn't feel like win 
at all...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san really is amazing...! But I 
didn't lose either...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Next chance, definitely...! I'll beat you, 
Tachyon-san...!
